### New in 1.1.0

- **Match HUD key picks.** When a player in a selected class dies, their portrait gets a white outline and a class callout until they respawn. Highlights work on both teams. Medic, Demoman and Sniper are selected by default. [See the in-game screenshot](https://github.com/JoeShade/CompHUD/blob/v1.1.0/screenshots/key-picks.png)
- **Scoreboard notes.** Save up to three reminders beside the scoreboard. Each reminder wraps independently, and you can hide the note while keeping its text.

Open **HUD Options** (the paint roller) and choose **Notes, key picks and shortcuts** to configure either feature. After changing key picks, click **OK** and restart TF2. The master switch remembers your class selections.

### HUD fixes

- Centred Engineer metal above the original ammo row and repositioned the build and destroy menus, building tooltip and item meters to give competitive captions room in both the standard and Pip-Boy layouts.
- Centred class icons inside their portrait panels and moved the kill feed down to clear the key-pick callouts.
- Fixed three bundled font paths so TF2 can load them on case-sensitive Linux installations.

### Installation

Close TF2, download **CompHUD.zip** from the release assets and extract the `CompHUD` folder into `Team Fortress 2/tf/custom`. If you're updating, first move your existing `CompHUD` folder to a backup location outside `tf/custom`. Your saved HUD preferences are in `tf/cfg`. [Installation and settings guide](https://github.com/JoeShade/CompHUD/blob/v1.1.0/docs/installation.md)
